HEADLINE: Pursuant to regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Chennai Meenakshi Multispecialty Hospital Limited ....
MORE:
Pursuant to regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Chennai Meenakshi Multispecialty Hospital Limited  has approved the reconstitution of the Audit Committee and the Stakeholders Relationship Committee via circular resolution passed on October 14, 2026.
This reconstitution has been necessitated consequent to the cessation of certain directors from the Board  and their respective committee positions upon the conclusion of the 36th  Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on September 30, 2026, to ensure continuous compliance under sections 177 and 178 of the Companies Act, 2013, and Regulations 18 and 20 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The updated composition of the respective committees are as per enclosed letter.
